name: Holding the intents across quests
vision_statement: Each AI representative starts every request from the standing view of the quests it is assigned and the intents above them, so a correction is made once and a thread is never restated.
opportunities: A representative works across many quests, so the standing view it needs is wider than any one request: past conversations, recent context, the guidance learned from corrections, the ledger of what was asked, the predictions made and the person's long-term goal. That opens questions the parent solution does not ask: how a correction is kept in the person's own words and tracked until it is followed, how a view is held per quest, per intent and per representative without crossing scopes, how a reply is aimed at the person's end without hijacking a simple question, and which representative a request runs as, the same way in chat, tasks and background work.
solution_coherence: Higher mind keeps the long view across turns. It carries what was said and found through Cross-conversation recall store and Scoped recent-context warm start. It keeps and applies a person's corrections through Verbatim feedback ledger and Feedback-to-guidance loop. It saves what was learned through Scoped prediction store and Context card persistence backend. It keeps work aimed at the person's end through Guidance toward the long-term goal, and picks the representative a request runs as through Representative selection. Representative selection sends the queued work of that representative through Queued-task runner.
